control_name: Every dimension key is unique over its published population
detail: a dimension with a duplicate key silently fans out every fact that joins to it

control_name: Every relationship resolves: no orphan key, so no blank member
detail: an unresolved key becomes a blank member in every visual that uses the dimension

control_name: Every declared many-to-one relationship is many-to-one in the data
detail: declaring a cardinality does not make the data have it; Power BI silently promotes a broken one to many-to-many and the totals stop meaning anything

control_name: No two tables are joined by more than one active path
detail: the reason every business-unit path is inactive: a fact reaches Business Unit through Entity, and a second direct route would make every segment total ambiguous

control_name: Every inactive relationship carries a written reason
detail: an inactive relationship is a decision; an undocumented one is a mistake nobody can tell apart from a decision

control_name: Every table carries a description a reader can use
Every measure carries a description
detail: a measure whose meaning lives only in its name is a measure two people will read two ways

control_name: Every high-risk measure states its definition, source and basis
detail: the measures a reader is most likely to be challenged on are the ones that must answer for themselves

control_name: Every measure sits in a display folder
Every numeric measure carries a format string
detail: an unformatted measure renders at full precision and makes a report look unfinished

control_name: Statement captions sort by their governed order, not alphabetically
detail: a P&L in alphabetical order starts at Cost of sales, and a balance sheet in alphabetical order is not a balance sheet

control_name: No fact key column is left visible to a report author
detail: a visible key invites someone to drag it onto a visual and summarise it

detail: deployed and refreshed from the same declarations the TMDL is written from

control_name: Actual is BLANK after the reporting close, never zero
detail: the mart publishes ACTUAL rows for the whole fiscal year carrying 0.00; without the guard September reads as a month the group earned nothing

control_name: Statutory, Adjusted and Covenant EBITDA are three separate definitions
detail: Covenant EBITDA reads the covenant bridge on a rolling twelve months, not an alias of Adjusted EBITDA. Even where two happened to agree they would still be separate measures with separate lineage

control_name: A month the agreement does not test is labelled Indicative
detail: the credit agreement tests at fiscal year ends (CA-009..012). Stamping BREACH on a date nobody tests is the Phase 5 defect, and it must not come back in DAX

control_name: Prior Year resolves to the governed derived version
detail: P7-D-01 seen from the semantic layer: a version code that resolves to nothing becomes a blank member here

control_name: No fact row falls to a blank Scenario member
detail: measured on the published data the model loads, so it is the model's own exposure

control_name: Statutory and management measures pin the basis they are named for
detail: read from the deployed model rather than from the source that generated it. Checked on the definition because in this baseline layer 4 is unpopulated and the two bases hold identical values, so a measure reading the wrong one would agree with everything

control_name: The current forecast version is the one the master marks as default
detail: three forecasts are retained and only one is current; a superseded forecast presented as the forecast is an error nobody would notice from the number alone

control_name: Doc comments only on objects that carry a Description
detail: a `///` above a relationship is a Description property the parser rejects (P6B-D-01); rationale travels as an annotation instead

control_name: No table name Power BI Desktop reserves
detail: 28 tables declared; reserved list ['measures'] confirmed against Desktop, not assumed (P6B-D-02)
